user_story: As a locked-out customer, I want a clear error message when I try to log in at https://www.saucedemo.com so that I understand why access is denied. Acceptance criteria: logging in with username 'locked_out_user' and password 'secret_sauce' keeps me on the login page and shows the error container [data-test="error"] with text containing 'Sorry, this user has been locked out'.
